room_rent.note: If room taken above limit, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction on other expenses if ICU limit exceeded

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay on every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI; room/ICU capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year, whichever lower; modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.) up to 50% of SI; room rent and ICU have per-day caps

initial_waiting.note: Excludes accidents; not applicable after 12 months continuous coverage

ped_waiting.note: Table of benefits mentions 4 years for declared PEDs; Section 6.1 states 36 months; longer period applies per policy wording

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement and osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Excl 18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate on claim; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; specific modern procedures listed under Section 4.6

domiciliary.note: Section 7.18 explicitly excludes domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure-A List I are explicitly excluded

global_cover.note: Section 10.7 restricts all treatment to India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly premium payment

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewal or porting

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; waiting period credits transferred

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, unproven treatments, adventure sports (professional)

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy wording
